data.purpose: Stable token, cost, percentage, and duration values.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Selection and refresh-state transitions; disabled under Reduce Motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A restrained native action using Signal Green.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.13 160); color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 600 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.50 0.12 160); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: oklch(0.44 0.105 160); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.72 0.10 160 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Period Filter
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.97 0.006 160); } .ds-filter button { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; color: oklch(0.50 0.014 160); background: transparent; font: 500 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-filter button.is-selected { color: oklch(0.44 0.105 160); background: oklch(0.94 0.035 160); font-weight: 600; } .ds-filter button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.13 160); }

components.name: Chart Surface
components.description: A tonal grouping surface without a decorative shadow.
components.css: .ds-chart { width: 320px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: oklch(0.20 0.016 160); background: oklch(0.97 0.006 160); font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-chart strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chart div { color: oklch(0.55 0.13 160); font: 600 28px ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 4px; }

narrative.overview: TokPeek feels like a precise instrument built into macOS: present when needed, silent when not. Native controls, compact hierarchy, and calm tonal surfaces keep usage understandable in two seconds.
keyCharacteristics: Native macOS behavior and control vocabulary
Monospaced numerals inside a system-sans interface
Tonal layering instead of decorative shadows
State motion only with a Reduce Motion fallback

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Signal Green occupies no more than ten percent of a surface.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Every changing numeric value uses monospaced digits.

rules.name: The One Window Rule
rules.body: The menu window owns elevation; internal content stays flat.

dos: Do preserve a two-second path to total usage and estimated cost.
Do use standard macOS settings controls and keyboard focus.
Do reserve Signal Green for selection, state, and primary action.
donts: Don't turn the panel into a dense web analytics dashboard.
Don't use neon gaming-monitor colors or crypto price-ticker urgency.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, gradient text, or nested cards.
